prompt: I have an agreed specification. Help me choose the next planning step. Keep this to a short recommendation; do not start the work.

prompt: Assess these supplied synthetic trial records against the requirement that claimed independent review must have an actual returned assessment. Do not run new trials. prompt: Assess whether this project needs a new local skill for the import problem. Use only the supplied files and incident notes; no host-session search. Recommendations only: do not create files, change rules or run agents. Check whether a smaller existing treatment already addresses it.

files.incidents.md: Incident A: an extensionless import failed on first run; fixed by using ./helper.mjs. Incident B, a separate task: an extensionless export failed; fixed the same way. files..github/workflows/check.yml:
name: check
on: [push]
jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      - run: node scripts/check-imports.mjs
